units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 38:6-8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVIII</cite> <he>אז … בטח וש׳ וכ׳</he> then Jacob dwelt in Canaan safe and undisturbed; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 138:1">Yalk. Gen. 138</cite> <he>בטח ש׳ ושליו</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:9">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> end <he>ומה … ש׳ ונחת שלוה והשקט</he> and what was created therein after he rested? Ease, rest, peace, and repose. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>זכורה אני בטחון וש׳ ושלוה שהייתי וכ׳</he> I remember the confidence and ease and contentment in which I used to dwell; a. e.
